Fix source.ts so apply(records) returns only unique enabled records with finite numeric amount, excluding booleans, null, strings and amounts <=0. Use first enabled valid occurrence per id, retain input order, and return {ids,total}. Run check.ts to verify the fix, then write answer.json {"tests_passed":true}. Do not alter check.ts or input fixtures. Do not simply hardcode expected ids. Retain the exported apply function.

files.content: export function apply(records: Array<{id:string;enabled:boolean;amount:unknown}>): {ids:string[];total:number} { const valid=records.filter(r=>r.enabled && Number(r.amount)>0); return {ids:valid.map(r=>r.id),total:valid.reduce((s,r)=>s+Number(r.amount),0)}; }
